item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Roasted, lightly smoked chicken with a seasonal cabbage mix steamed in butter and thyme, new potatoes and blueberry sauce, topped with parsley. Served with classic cucumber salad. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Mexican-inspired pork tenderloin with citrus, chilli and warm spices, served with roasted sweet potatoes and topped with esquites. Served with pico de gallo and coriander. The dish is gluten free. (6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mexican-inspired bean stew with citrus, chilli and warm spices, served with roasted sweet potatoes and topped with esquites. Served with pico de gallo and coriander. The dish is gluten free. (6+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Roast pork shank with crispy crackling, cavolo nero, pan-fried potatoes and parsley emulsion. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish Vegan meatballs with pan-fried potatoes, cavolo nero and parsley emulsion. (15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Turkey marinated in plenty of herbs and spices, couscous tabbouleh with fresh greens, herbs, dried fruit and nuts. Served with fresh citrus and sumac yoghurt. (1+4+6+9+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Marinated aubergine with couscous tabbouleh with fresh greens, herbs, dried fruit and nuts. Served with fresh citrus and sumac yoghurt. (1+4+6+9+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Fish cakes and potatoes tossed in butter sauce and parsley, topped with peas tossed with dill. Served with lemon, coarse remoulade, tartar sauce and a raw salad of apple and hazelnuts. Also available gluten free. (1+2+3+6+9+11) GREEN DISH: Dish Pea protein cakes and potatoes tossed in butter sauce and parsley, topped with peas tossed with dill. Served with lemon, coarse remoulade, tartar sauce and a raw salad of apple and hazelnuts. Also available gluten free, with vegan dressings on offer. (1+2+6+9+11)
